description: This file defines the Coupon class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling coupon application, validation, and history management during checkout.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Handles coupon total calculation, validation, and history management in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies coupon discounts to the order total, adjusts taxes, and updates the totals array.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates and records coupon usage upon order confirmation, preventing overuse.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes coupon usage records associated with an order when it is canceled or modified.
